kinds.d: Mild, pH-balanced wash for cleaning the external intimate area.
Gel or liquid applied to reduce friction during sex or intimate use.
Squeeze bulb or nozzle device for rinsing the rectum with water.

notes: Intimate wash: cut the three Femfresh SKUs (Daily, Deodorising, Sensitive) to one representative model. Kept EpZen as a second brand. Dropped the 'Femfresh Intimate Hygiene' range, which belongs in the brand register as briefed. Kept the Hello Period range because the brief does not mention it. Personal lubricant: the four Astroglide SKUs differed only by base and form, so base now lives in the types (water-, silicone-, oil-based). Gel versus liquid is a form attribute and was not listed as a type. Kept one water-based and one silicone model. Dropped the 'Astroglide lubricants' range, which belongs in the brand register as briefed. Anal douche: kept at kind level with no models; it plausibly has a personal owner. Restraint-only shelf, so no new brands were researched; each kind keeps fewer than the 3–5 brands the brief targets. Definitions were rewritten and old sources kept.
